ai engineer: Learn Python, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, TensorFlow and build AI projects.
machine learning engineer: Learn Python, statistics, machine learning algorithms and model deployment.
data scientist: Learn Python, Pandas, statistics, machine learning and data visualization.
data analyst: Learn Excel, SQL, Python and Power BI or Tableau.
web developer: Learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React and backend development.
mobile developer: Learn Java/Kotlin for Android or Swift for iOS development.
software engineer: Learn programming, data structures, algorithms and system design.
cyber security: Learn networking, Linux, ethical hacking and penetration testing.
cloud engineer: Learn AWS, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes and cloud architecture.
devops engineer: Learn CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, automation and Linux.
game developer: Learn C++, Unity, Unreal Engine and game design.
blockchain developer: Learn Solidity, Ethereum and smart contract development.
ui ux designer: Learn Figma, design thinking, wireframing and prototyping.
database administrator: Learn SQL, database design and database optimization.
network engineer: Learn networking concepts, routers, switches and security.
robotics engineer: Learn robotics programming, electronics and AI.
embedded systems engineer: Learn C/C++, microcontrollers and IoT systems.
bioinformatics: Learn biology, Python, genome analysis and bio data science.
doctor: Study MBBS, medical sciences and clinical practice.
lawyer: Study LLB, legal research and court practice.
chartered accountant: Study accounting, auditing, taxation and finance.
business analyst: Learn business analysis, data analytics and Excel.
product manager: Learn product strategy, user research and agile development.
digital marketing: Learn SEO, social media marketing and online advertising.
civil engineer: Study structural design, construction and infrastructure.
mechanical engineer: Learn mechanics, thermodynamics and CAD design.
electrical engineer: Learn circuits, power systems and electrical machines.
electronics engineer: Learn embedded systems and communication systems.
research scientist: Focus on scientific research and advanced subject knowledge.
